messages: Overworld sprite missing for ARCEUS; using the placeholder.
playtest_entity_soak.note: Re-pinned 1 -> 2 (infinite-world slice 2, 2026-08-02): the climate pools along the entity soak's seeded band now include ARCEUS (the full-catalog fallback path); the overworld sprite table has no ARCEUS entry, so the DESIGNED tiered fallback (overworld_not_found.png) renders it and warns — honest placeholder, not a render regression.

playtest_soak.note: Re-pinned 3 -> 10 (infinite-world slice 2, 2026-08-02): the climate-field biome model changed the pools along the soak's seeded walk band, so its battles now encounter a variety of species carrying unimplemented battle effects (SWAGGER/DISABLE/GUST/ROLLOUT/FORESIGHT/RAPID_SPIN/SPLASH — the engine's documented partial coverage plays them as plain hits and warns, the honest fallback). Same warning CLASS as the pinned 2, higher frequency under the new terrain.
